passages.text: On the Enterprise plan, audit logs are retained for 400 days.
On the Team plan, audit logs are retained for 90 days.
Changelog 2024-05-01: Team plan audit log retention increased from 30 days to 90 days.
A failed nightly export is retried three times, 15 minutes apart.
SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan.
Only a user with the organization owner role can configure SAML single sign-on.
Data for workspaces created in the EU region is stored in Frankfurt.
Each API token may send up to 600 requests per minute.
A single file upload may not exceed 2 GB.
